notes.title: 🎃 Halloween 2023 Big Demo Update 🎃
notes.notes:
100MB of new content after a year of development!


Nearly 50-100 new interactive props
Taxes and [#REDACTED#]
Improved cooking, including dough, bread, sandwiches, eggs, butter, veggies and more!
New trick or treaters with improved dialogue and reactivity to your actions!
New special NPCs with their own mechanic!
Whole new Dust™ system
New Cat AI behavior!
Muscles, body types, hormones and obesity!
New enemies!
New phone numbers and pranks!
A bunch of new secrets! Can you find the gun?
Breakable doors and new peep hole feature
Improved menu with sound effects and key rebinding
Basic gamepad support (might be broken)
Grenades
Obliteration
Improved rats!
Clothes can now burn while wearing them
Dripping!
Body Jaunting (locked demo feature)
And more!


Wishlist and share with your favorite streamers, youtubers and other content machines. I'm sure they'll have a good time...Or at least it'll be funny to watch.

Thanks!
